name: Hawkins National Laboratory
description: A covert government facility run by Dr. Martin Brenner. It houses the Gate to the Upside Down and was used to develop Eleven's psychic abilities.

name: Byers House
description: The modest home of Joyce Byers and her sons Will and Jonathan. The Christmas-light communication board was strung across its living room wall.

name: Wheeler House
description: Home of the Wheeler family on Cornwallis Avenue. Mike's basement serves as the Party's headquarters and Eleven's first refuge.

name: Hawkins Middle School
description: Where Mike, Will, Dustin, and Lucas attend school. The final showdown with the Demogorgon takes place here.

name: Mirkwood
description: A stretch of forest road southeast of Hawkins where Will was last seen. Kerley Road runs through it toward the Lab.

name: Castle Byers
description: Will's secret hideout in the woods — a fort of scavenged wood and sheets. Its Upside Down mirror is where Will hides from the Demogorgon.

name: Hawkins Police Department
description: Chief Hopper's base of operations. Small-town and underfunded, it becomes the nerve center for the search for Will.

name: Palace Arcade
description: The local arcade where the boys spend their free time. A mysterious high score by 'MADMAX' is spotted here in Season 2.

name: Sattler Quarry
description: A flooded quarry on the far east outskirts of Hawkins. A decoy body is found here, leading the town to believe Will is dead.

name: Hopper's Cabin
description: Chief Hopper's remote cabin in the southwest woods. Later becomes Eleven's secret home after the events of Season 1.

name: The Gate
description: A tear in reality at the heart of Hawkins Lab, created when Eleven made contact with the Demogorgon. The source of all Upside Down intrusions.

name: Benny's Burgers
description: A diner run by Benny Hammond, who gives Eleven food after her escape from the lab — before agents from Hawkins Lab silence him.

name: The Tunnels
description: A network of vine-choked tunnels spreading beneath Hawkins, the root system of the Upside Down. Will's visions map their paths under the town.

name: Merrill's Pumpkin Patch
description: A farm south of Hawkins where the soil turns black and pumpkins rot from the inside — the first visible sign of the Upside Down's spread.

name: Murray's Bunker
description: The cluttered home-office of conspiracy journalist Murray Bauman, fortified with security cameras and full of files on Hawkins Lab.

name: Hawkins Public Library
description: The town's public library where Bob Newby works and where the group researches the Upside Down's history.

name: Hawkins Memorial Hospital
description: The local hospital where Will is treated for his episodes and where the doctors struggle to understand his connection to the shadow monster.

name: The Junkyard
description: A scrapyard on the outskirts where the kids build a base to trap Dart, and where Billy confronts Steve in a brutal fight.

name: Hawkins Community Pool
description: The public pool where Billy works as a lifeguard. A place of summer leisure that becomes a site of Mind Flayer manipulation.

name: Chicago
description: Where Kali Prasad (Eight) leads a gang of outcasts. Eleven travels here to learn about her past and her powers before returning to Hawkins.

name: Starcourt Mall
description: A massive new shopping mall in Hawkins that becomes the epicenter of the Russian invasion. The Scoops Ahoy ice cream parlor hides a secret elevator to the underground base.

name: Russian Base
description: A secret Russian facility built beneath Starcourt Mall, housing a massive machine that tears open gates to the Upside Down.

name: Lovers Lake
description: A secluded lake near Hawkins where the Mind Flayer takes root, building a physical body from the melted remains of rats and townspeople.

name: Brimborn Steelworks
description: An abandoned steel mill where the Mind Flayer assembles its physical form from the consumed biomass of Hawkins residents.

name: Creel House
description: A dilapidated Victorian house where Henry Creel first used his powers to kill his family. It becomes a nexus for Vecna's curse and the site of the final battle.

name: Pennhurst Mental Hospital
description: A psychiatric facility where Victor Creel was institutionalized after the murder of his family. Robin and Nancy infiltrate it to learn the truth about Vecna's origins.

name: Byers House (California)
description: The Byers family's new home in Lenora Hills, California. A modest suburban house where Eleven struggles to fit in and agents eventually attack.

name: NINA Facility
description: A secret government facility housing the NINA tank — a sensory deprivation device that lets Eleven relive her suppressed memories from Hawkins Lab.

name: Hawkins High School
description: The local high school where the Party now attends. Home of the Hellfire Club, the basketball team, and ground zero for the Satanic panic that grips Hawkins.

name: Hawkins Quarantine Zone
description: The military-controlled perimeter around Hawkins after the gates tore the town apart. Armed patrols, checkpoints, and a growing refugee camp define the new Hawkins.

name: The Abyss
description: A vast, dark void beyond the Upside Down — the true source of the Mind Flayer's power. Dustin theorizes the Upside Down is merely a "bridge" to this deeper dimension.

name: Henry's Psychic Realm
description: A shared psychic space inside Vecna's mind where Holly and Max are trapped. It's built from Henry Creel's memories — a labyrinth of childhood trauma and spider imagery.
